reason: The hypothesis relies on extrapolating Pd-based HEA results to Cu, but the cited evidence only speculates about Cu's potential and provides no direct data on mechanical or magnetocaloric performance of Cu-containing MnNiSi alloys. The premises about mechanical improvement and magnetocaloric retention in MnNiSi are unsupported by the cited passages.
premises: Cu addition to NiFeCoCr-based HEAs can tune magnetic properties similarly to Pd
Cu addition reduces materials cost compared to Pd
HEAs exhibit superior mechanical properties aiding manufacturability
Magnetocaloric effect can be retained with FCC metal additives
Room temperature operation is achievable with tuned HEAs
